title: Main board - every access point the recovery chapters use (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)

callouts.label: UART0 header, 3 holes
callouts.note: UART0 header, 3 holes: chapters 1, 3, 4, 5. Pin 1 at the dot end (bottom), pin 3 GND at the top (J-112).

callouts.label: Empty DIP footprint, common row + 3 straps
callouts.note: Empty DIP footprint, common row + 3 straps: chapter 1 (J-098).

callouts.label: SOP strap pads: X4 SOP0, X5 SOP1, X6 SOP2
callouts.note: SOP strap pads: chapters 1, 3, 5. Three tinned pads right of J14, X4 at the top (J-098); roles by beeper to U1 pins 35/34/21, raptox 2026-11-05 (J-137).

callouts.label: Bench power in, 5 V
callouts.note: Bench power in, 5 V: every powered chapter. Pin 1 (square, bottom) VIN, pin 2 GND (J-080).

callouts.label: SPI flash
callouts.note: SPI flash: pin 8 = 3V3 meter point and strap source, pin 1 = CS (J-108, J-110).

callouts.label: CC3220S
callouts.note: CC3220S: SOP pins 21/34/35 for the beeper, chapter 1.

callouts.label: 30-way FFC to the power board
callouts.note: FFC out in every bench session; power only (pins 1-6 VIN, J-077).

callouts.label: 3.3 V regulator
callouts.note: 3.3 V regulator: measure IN/OUT if the rail is missing, chapter 3 (NCP59800, J-076).
